description: At least 180 seconds of continuous simulated hand and independent head motion across six ordinary iDroid open/use/stow/reopen cycles in guarded Mission10020 field gameplay. Run with tools/workspace.py bot --command run --record --suite tools/gameplay_bot/suites/idroid-continuous-roundtrip.json. It changes no saves/settings and performs no purchases, firing, mission navigation or tutorial skipping. Endpoint/state passes require separate continuous visual review before acceptance.

review_requires: Review complete recorded opening, independent headset motion, device cant/yaw and recovery in native source-eye video.
Review both final-eye checkpoints for attached hands/forearms, native right-hand handset/projector, world continuity and left-arm HUD.
Pose packets use separate grip/aim RPCs; do not claim atomic physical controller samples or headset acceptance.
Review EVERY opening/stow boundary frame; reject absent/translucent arms, detached handset or a snap on immediate reopening.
The next case reopens with the established hand/head pose. No extra hand setup is permitted between cycles.
The native closing diagnostic can outlive visible prop rendering; a stale closing flag does not prove animation or visibility.
